artifacts.angle: Society tells us that a four-year university degree is the safest ticket to wealth. The reality is that debt-financed general education delays wealth accumulation by a decade. The rule is to buy specific, high-leverage skills through targeted apprenticeships or certificates that generate immediate cash flow.
artifacts.hook: Your university degree cost you forty thousand dollars and four years, while a six-week certification just outearned it.
